exercise.title: Ladung, Strom
exercise.short_solution:
$I(t)=\begin{cases} 
0 & \text{f"ur} t<0 

2\frac{Q_1}{t_1^2}t & \text{f"ur} 0 \leq t < t_1

0 & \text{f"ur} t_1 \leq t < t_2

-\frac{2Q_1}{t_3-t_2} & \text{f"ur} t_2 \leq t < t_3

\frac{Q_1}{\tau}\cdot \text{exp}\left(-\frac{t-t_3}{\tau}\right) & \text{f"ur} t_3 \leq t \end{cases}$
